title: Switch app background to topo-light/topo-dark, sync with system theme
description:
New assets img/topo-light.webp and img/topo-dark.webp have been added. Replace the current default background (train.webp) with these:

- Light mode → img/topo-light.webp
- Dark mode → img/topo-dark.webp
- Background must switch automatically when the theme changes.
- Theme default should be "System" (follow OS light/dark preference) if a default/theme setting exists and isn't already System.
- Background image must render at 0 transparency (fully opaque) and 0 blur (no blur filter/effect) — remove any existing opacity/blur styling applied to the background.

Find where train.webp is currently referenced/set as the background (CSS, theme config, component, etc.) and update all relevant places. Verify light/dark switching works and there's no leftover reference to train.webp for the default background.
label: Feature

activity.content:
## Completed

- Replaced the shipped default with theme-aware topo wallpaper: `img/topo-light.webp` in light mode and `img/topo-dark.webp` in dark mode.
- Kept the existing default theme as `System`; CSS media-query resolution switches the wallpaper automatically with OS theme changes, while explicit Light and Dark selections override it.
- Forced the shipped wallpaper to full opacity and zero blur, including when stale photo-adjustment values exist.
- Mirrored both WebP assets and runtime changes into `meridian-extension/`.
- Added focused regression coverage for theme resolution, neutral photo effects, and packaged assets.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 135 tests passed.
- `git diff --check` — clean.
- Runtime source, packaged runtime, and tests contain no `train.webp` references.
- Source and packaged topo assets are byte-identical valid WebP files.

Regression found in review: the Transparency/Blur sliders no longer show in Settings for the default background.

Root cause: DEFAULT_BACKGROUND was changed to `{ type: "theme", value: "topo" }`, but `isPhotoBackground(bg)` in components/SettingsPanel.js (~line 149, mirrored in meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js) only returns true for `type === "photo"` or `"custom"`. It was never updated for the new "theme" type, so `buildPhotoAdjust()` never gets appended for the shipped topo wallpaper — sliders vanish. Custom/uploaded photo backgrounds are unaffected.

Fix: update `isPhotoBackground` to also treat `bg?.type === "theme"` as slider-eligible (or otherwise account for the new default background type), and confirm `applyPhotoAdjustments` still correctly applies opacity/blur CSS vars to the topo wallpaper afterward. Apply the same fix to the mirrored copy in meridian-extension/. Re-verify default (0 opacity-loss/0 blur) still holds when sliders are at their neutral position, and that adjusting the sliders actually affects the topo background live.

## Completed

- Restored Transparency and Blur controls for the shipped theme-aware topo background by treating `type: "theme"` as an adjustable image background.
- Applied the fix to both `components/SettingsPanel.js` and the mirrored `meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js`.
- Updated regression coverage to verify neutral defaults remain fully opaque with zero blur, and non-neutral slider values update the live opacity/blur CSS variables.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/themeBackground.test.mjs` — 2 passed.
- `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` — 135 passed.
- `git diff --check` — clean.
- Source and packaged component files remain byte-identical.
